name: Jumbie
description: Jumbie (also jumbee) is a broad term from Caribbean folklore for supernatural entities — primarily spirits of the dead but also nature spirits, shapeshifters, and other beings — rooted in West and Central African traditions carried to the Caribbean through the transatlantic slave trade.

aliases.name: Duppy
aliases.meaning: Cognate term used in Jamaica and Barbados for ancestral ghost spirits

aliases.name: Mendo
aliases.meaning: Alternative name in Colombia and Venezuela

aliases.name: Chongo
aliases.meaning: Additional alternative name in Colombia and Venezuela

aliases.name: Mocko Jumbie
aliases.meaning: Stilt-dancer figure associated with carnival; protective spirit embodiment

origin: English-speaking Caribbean territories, primarily those with British colonial history. Also present in Guyana and some South American territories. Related traditions in French Caribbean (zombi) and Jamaica/Barbados (duppy).
